behavior: Record attempted cleanup signals and errors. Attempt cleanup of every owned child. Forced or incomplete cleanup raises after cleanup. Successful cleanup does not erase an earlier Wine failure.
scope: Five production run_client unit cases use mocked processes/signals and filesystem fixtures. A separate actual selection-only native normal-close case is linked below. Forced native fallback remains untested.
historical_runs: Unchanged. This fix does not prove that earlier client shutdowns avoided forced termination.
